seriesName: CoreWeave MLPerf Training v6.0: DeepSeek-V3 671B training time by GPU cluster size (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72)
notes: This series does not directly measure the bullet's specific '10x tokens per megawatt, Vera Rubin vs Blackwell' claim -- CoreWeave's Vera Rubin NVL72 blog post (wf.coreweave.com/blog/what-it-takes-to-bring-up-a-multi-rack-nvidia-vera-rubin-nvl72-cluster and www.coreweave.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-nvl72-on-coreweave-10x-more-tokens-per-megawatt-than-blackwell) states only the 10x ratio and a qualitative chart shape, with no other bare numeric values usable under rule 9. Instead, this series contextualizes the story: it is CoreWeave's own published, same-site MLPerf Training v6.0 results (June 16, 2026) showing DeepSeek-V3 671B training time falling as GPU count rises on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 -- the current Blackwell-generation hardware that Vera Rubin NVL72 is being measured against -- demonstrating the kind of at-scale performance benchmarking CoreWeave is now extending to Vera Rubin. All three points come from the single CoreWeave news page cited above.
